page.notes: Running head "INDEX X." is printed at the top centre. No page number is printed. The signature "bbb 4" is at the foot right, followed by a small mark that may be a page indicator; it is not transcribed. The printed line "Paternitatis genera duo inter se com" and "Perfarum de maleficiis lex" are running on from the page's column ends and are kept as printed. "Pet us" in the printed text is set with a space and is transcribed as Petrus. "Peccari author" and "Petri fimulatio" are printed as shown. Two lines in the right column are slightly faded and read with some uncertainty, but are not marked. Some short entries use spaces where the print has ligatures.
